news.title: BNY Gives Banks Cross-Border Wallet Reach Without Building Their Own Infrastructure
news.body: BNY used its October 15 earnings call to detail Pay-to-Wallet, introduced in the third quarter, which lets banks send cross-border payments from bank accounts to retail digital wallets. Banks can retain the originating customer relationship while using BNY’s infrastructure to reach recipients outside bank-account payout channels. Banks evaluating the service can focus procurement on supported wallets, currencies, corridors and payout limits rather than building their own wallet connections.

news.title: Kraken Parent Targets Deposits And Card Issuance Through Saldo Bank Deal
news.body: Payward, Kraken’s parent, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank and its Finnish holding company, with closing expected in 2027 and financial terms undisclosed. The acquisition would add banking capabilities beyond Payward’s Irish electronic-money license, supporting its plans for interest-bearing deposits, lending and banking-as-a-service, including card issuance. Regulatory clearance and country-specific product plans now determine how much of that offering Payward can deliver across Saldo’s five European markets.

news.title: Spiko’s $90 Million Round Backs Tokenized Funds Competing For Surplus Cash
news.body: Spiko announced a $90 million Series B led by NEA and reported $2.7 billion placed in its funds, more than five times the level a year earlier. Its app- and API-accessible funds give treasury platforms another way to distribute surplus-cash investments across euros, dollars, sterling and Swiss francs, competing with money left in bank accounts. Distributors evaluating an integration must distinguish fund investments from insured deposits and assess liquidity, currency coverage and customer disclosures.

news.title: Intuit Targets Usage-Based Billing And Collections With Proposed Sequence Acquisition
news.body: Intuit announced plans to acquire Sequence, whose revenue-management tools support consumption-, usage-, seat- and milestone-based pricing, billing and collections. The proposed deal would broaden Enterprise Suite’s mid-market offering, bringing more billing functionality into the accounting platform used by B2B software and professional-services businesses. For finance teams evaluating the combined product, the practical questions are whether integration preserves payment-provider choice and how it connects collections with reconciliation.

news.title: Ledger Investigation Puts Hardware Wallet Distribution Chains Under Renewed Security Scrutiny
news.body: PYMNTS, citing Bloomberg, reported that Ledger was investigating hardware tampering associated with $90 million in drained cryptocurrency and had asked distributors in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong to halt sales. Ledger said it had no indication that its infrastructure, systems, services or direct-sales channel had been compromised, putting distribution-chain integrity at the center of the investigation. Crypto businesses and custody teams can tighten approved purchasing channels and device-provenance checks while awaiting findings on affected batches and remediation.

perspective: BNY details wallet payouts as Kraken’s parent pursues banking capabilities, alongside tokenized cash funds, billing consolidation and hardware-wallet security.

curiosity.text: SWIFT began live messaging in 1977. The network securely transmits payment instructions between financial institutions; it does not hold or move money itself. Banks use those instructions to settle payments through their accounts and payment systems.
